body.title: `rad job show` only shows the first job COB associated with a specific OID

edits.body: Note: I thought the theory was that there would only be one job COB per commit....  that doesn't seem to hold true, which does make more sense in a distributed system.
[never mind, this was a superfluous comment]

discussion.body: Side note: https://cci.rad.levitte.org//e188383c-c73b-4716-998a-e51225e17ea5.html shows that the run did finish (with failure).  Why wasn't that recorded?  Perhaps that belongs with radicle-ci-broker, and @liw can tell.

edits.body: Side note: https://cci.rad.levitte.org//e188383c-c73b-4716-998a-e51225e17ea5.html shows that the run did finish (with failure).  Why wasn't that recorded?  Perhaps that belongs with radicle-ci-broker, and @liw can tell.

discussion.body:
I got sufficiently irritated with this today that I might have a go at making the change so `rad job show` shows *all* job COBs for the specified commit.

I know that's not "right" visavi the theory that one commit should only have one associated job COB, but until that's a reality, it is better if the command can display the current reality.
